dedupe_keys.name: lightbox smartfabric us parcel building footprint address assessment and zoning data

description: LightBox sells property and location data for commercial real estate, built around its SmartFabric core data asset of parcel boundaries, structures and addresses linked by a common LightBox ID. Coverage: the United States, with separate Canadian data offerings; the parcel data claim 100 percent nationwide coverage with boundaries for hundreds of millions of properties and more than 300 attributes, ownership updated daily, and assessed land and improvement values and taxes going back up to 30 years; the building footprint data claim 100 percent nationwide building coverage with height, ground elevation and number of stories, compiled from satellite and aerial imagery and authoritative sources; further core datasets cover addresses to building level, geocoding, zoning, transaction history, confidence-scored true owners and corporate parents of commercial properties. Format and access: bulk downloads in CSV, SHP and FGDB, the LightBox API, an ArcGIS feature service, delivery through Snowflake, and the LightBox Vision mapping platform (formerly LandVision); sold on contact. Licence: commercial; not read. Caveats: prices and update cycles for each layer other than ownership are not given on the pages read; coverage claims are the vendor's. Simulation uses: parcel and building inventories with heights and values for hazard exposure and loss estimation, land use in capacity planning, and property layers in urban digital twins. Related records: Ecopia AI building and land cover vectors (data-ecopia-ai-vector-maps-buildings-land-cover-transport) Nearmap imagery (data-nearmap-aerial-imagery-and-ai-layers) and Regrid parcels (data-regrid-parcel-data).
